# Confirmed checkout decisions

Intent: shoppers submit payment and receive an order confirmation.
Flow: enter payment, submit, then confirmation.
Reuse `Button` from `src/ui/Button.jsx` for Pay.
Pending: submission disables Pay and changes its accessible name to Processing.
Error: show an inline payment error, move focus to it, then allow retry.
Responsive: below existing `md`, stack fields and keep Pay after the last field.
Accessibility: every field has a persistent label; the error is announced once and receives focus.
No new primitive is required.

prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill to compile and verify the confirmed decisions in ./aidd_docs/tasks/2026_08/2026_08_22_checkout/decisions.md. Write ./aidd_docs/tasks/2026_08/2026_08_22_checkout/ui.md. Do not ask questions, invent decisions, write production code, or modify source and project memory.

expect.judge: Engineering can implement the flow, pending and error recovery, responsive behavior, and accessibility acceptance behavior without guessing. The contract names the existing Button and no new primitive, but contains no React, CSS, or arbitrary implementation prescription.
